body: Created folders belong to a game installation, not to one package, so they are not added to each package's `directories` (exclusive folders only). Keeping `list --json` as an array avoids breaking consumers. `--download` is opt-in because a dry run must have no network or cache side effect unless the user asks; it validates that the cache is outside every game before downloading and is rejected without `--dry-run` or for standalone archives.
summary: The milestone 4 live run found that `list` hid the created-directory ledger and that catalog dry runs could not plan files for uncached `https` archives. Modn now prints the per-game created folders in `modn list` text and reports them as `created_directories` in `doctor --json`. `list --json` stays an array of packages. `install --dry-run --download` fetches missing `https` archives into the verified cache; a dry run still never downloads by default and never writes the game.
title: Created-folder ledger is reported by list text and doctor JSON; dry runs download only with --download

body: Checkpoints: a red4ext 1.31.0 + cet 1.38.1; b redscript 0.5.32 + codeware 1.21.2; c virtual-atelier 1.6.4 with archivexl 1.28.6 and mod-settings 0.2.28; d equipment-ex 1.2.10 with tweakxl 1.12.0, then browser-extension 0.9.7, then no-intro-videos 0.8. Limits: the backup was a SHA-256 manifest only, so Steam verification is the only restore path. The c and d launch reports were general, with no specific in-game feature checks. Residue the user chose to keep: 21 runtime files, 7 folders, a rewritten redscript_rCURRENT.log, and 4 older redscript logs removed by redscript's rotation. The run's three Modn gaps were fixed in PRs #45 and #46. The raw manifests and diffs are outside the repository, in the user's local modn-live folder.
summary: On a real Steam Cyberpunk 2077 installation (game 3.0.88.46235), the 11-package prerequisite stack installed through `modn install` in four user-authorized checkpoints. The user launched the game after each checkpoint and reported success. `modn uninstall` removed all 11 packages (137 owned files) in reverse order. The game tree then matched the preflight manifest except for runtime files the game created.
title: Milestone 4 live Cyberpunk validation passed on 2026-11-02

body: Each kind of fact has one home: README.md for shipped behavior, GitHub for planned work and its status, memory for decisions, findings and failures, AGENTS.md for agent rules. Milestones 1-4 are complete; their text is in git history (roadmap.md at 655fc79). Milestone 5 became GitHub milestone 1, 'Windows-first alpha and package lifecycle', with issues #47-#50. The roadmap's deferred list became issues #51-#60.
summary: roadmap.md kept going out of date because it held status that README.md and memory also held. It is removed. Product direction is in VISION.md. Planned work is in GitHub milestones (exit gate in the description) and issues closed by PRs with `Fixes #n`. Deferred work is issues with the `deferred` label. Milestone results are recorded in memory as findings.
title: Planned work moved from roadmap.md to GitHub milestones and issues
